newsitem.title: CHINA: Liu Chong Hing Bk ups mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Liu Chong Hing Bk ups mortgage rate.

text.p: Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd said it would raise its mortgage rates by 25 basis points to 9.50 percent with effect from Tuesday.

"Presently the mortgage rate is 9.25 percent, it will be raised to 9.50 percent," said L.Y. Nam, executive director of the bank. "If customers are professionals and have a long term relation with our bank, the rate will be lowered."
Nam said the new mortgage rate would come into effect from Tuesday.
Hongkong Bank and Standard Chartered Bank had earlier this month raised their mortgage rates by 25 basis points to 9.25 percent.
Nam also said the bank was not currently considering any mortgage securitisation plan.
